title: Concrete decalage representatives and the right-interval page embedding
statement: Let \(C\) be an abelian category, \(U=(K,F)\) a filtered cochain complex, \(D=\operatorname{Dec}(F)\) [lem-sp-filtered-complex-decalage], \(p,q,r\in\mathbb Z\), \(r\ge2\), and \(n=p+q\). Write \(R_r^{p,n}\) for the original unquotiented cycle representative pullback. Construct its unique lift to \(D^{-q}K^n\); for \(a\le-q\) its projection to \(D^a/D^{1-q}\) is a cycle. At \(a=1-(q+r-1)\), denote its class by \(c_r\). Define the monic embedding \(m_r\) of the decalage spectral-object page [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower] in \(H^n(D^{1-(q+r-1)}/D^{1-q})\) using the kernel sequence of the four-index page and the cone-to-quotient comparison, and the first-page isomorphism when \(r=2\). A page isomorphism \(e\) from the original quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-canonical-model] is normalized when \(z\pi_r e m_r=c_r\) for every representative projection \(z\) satisfying its quotient square. This equation uniquely determines \(e\).
